v3::en::Runway开源了Python库confingy，旨在解决机器学: Runway open sourced the Python library confingy, aiming to solve the long-term pain points of machine learning system configuration. This library allows developers to replace traditional YAML configuration files with pure Python code (supporting lazy loading, type checking and serialization), thereby getting rid of the maintenance dilemma caused by YAML as a complete domain-specific language in Turing. Confingy can meet core needs such as tracking constructor parameters and avoiding instantiation of expensive objects (such as large language models) without refactoring existing code. It effectively improves development experience problems such as inability to jump to definitions, invalid type hints, and difficulty in refactoring due to complex YAML configurations.

v3::en::SimWorld Studio是一个基于Unreal Engin: SimWorld Studio is an open source platform based on Unreal Engine 5, designed to automatically generate dynamically evolving 3D interactive environments for embodied agent learning. Its core is the tool-enhanced coding agent SimCoder, which can write engine code according to instructions to build a physically real world, and evolves itself through verification feedback, corrects the environment, and accumulates reusable skills. The generated environment is exported with a standardized interface for agent training. The platform also realizes the co-evolution of environment generation and agent learning: based on the agent's performance feedback, SimCoder generates adaptive courses near its ability boundaries, so that the difficulty of the environment increases as the agent progresses. In the case of embodied navigation, this solution significantly improves the generalization performance of the agent.

v3::en::现有无评论者RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，易导致约束忽: Existing reviewer-free RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards through arithmetic averaging, which easily leads to constraint neglect: a high score on a single objective may mask serious failures in other key objectives (such as security or format), thereby hiding low-performance bottleneck rewards that affect reliable alignment. This study proposes Reward Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance in advantage aggregation and changes the optimization goal from "maximizing sum" to "maximizing consistency". Analysis shows that RVPO can effectively identify and increase the contribution of bottleneck rewards, and achieve more balanced policy optimization in multi-goal alignment tasks such as security and format compliance.

v3::en::研究人员提出文本条件联合嵌入预测架构（TC-JEPA），通过引入: The researchers proposed the Text Conditional Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture (TC-JEPA) to reduce visual uncertainty in mask feature prediction by introducing image description text as condition information. This method employs a fine-grained text conditioner to compute sparse cross-attention on input text markers to modulate the predicted image patch features. Compared with I-JEPA based on mask feature prediction, TC-JEPA can learn visual representations with richer semantics, solving the problem of insufficient semantic learning caused by visual uncertainty in the original method.
v3::en::研究发现，强化学习改进大语言模型推理时，并非教授新策略，而是对基: Research has found that when reinforcement learning improves large language model reasoning, it does not teach new strategies, but redistributes probabilities for solutions already mastered by the basic model. Its effective impact is only concentrated on 1-3% of high-entropy decision-making tokens, and the improved tokens are always among the top 5 alternatives of the basic model. Based on this, the researchers proposed the ReasonMaxxer method that does not require reinforcement learning. It only applies contrast loss at the decision point of entropy gating, requiring only hundreds of basic model deductions and no need for online generation. In multiple model and mathematical reasoning benchmark tests, this method reaches or exceeds the performance of full reinforcement learning, while training only requires dozens of questions and several minutes of single GPU time, and the cost is reduced by about three orders of magnitude.
v3::en::研究发现，部分已发布的模型存在有限的意外对思维链（CoT）进行评: Research has found that some published models have limited cases of unexpected chain-of-thought (CoT) scoring. The team has repaired the affected reward pathways and confirmed there is no clear evidence that the model's monitorability is reduced as a result. This shows that the impact of unexpected scoring on CoT in current reinforcement learning training is limited and does not have a negative impact on monitoring capabilities after repair.
v3::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.

v3::en::针对LLM多智能体系统在长程任务中因关键错误扩散导致整体失败的问: Aiming at the problem of overall failure of the LLM multi-agent system due to the proliferation of critical errors in long-distance tasks, this study proposes the online audit framework AgentForesight. The framework observes trajectory prefixes in real time during task execution and issues alerts at the earliest critical errors. The research constructed the AFTraj-2K trajectory corpus, and developed the AgentForesight-7B model based on this. The model is trained using a coarse-to-fine reinforcement learning strategy. In AFTraj-2K and external benchmarks, its performance surpasses leading proprietary models such as GPT-4.1, achieving performance improvements of up to +19.9% ​​and reducing step positioning errors by 3 times, thus shifting fault handling from post-hoc attribution to deployment-time intervention.
v3::en::针对离散流匹配生成文本需数百步迭代的问题，本研究提出轨迹塑形离散: Aiming at the problem that generating text through discrete flow matching requires hundreds of iterations, this study proposes a trajectory shaping discrete flow matching method. In traditional distillation, the quality of trajectories constructed from random jumps is the performance bottleneck. The new method introduces a lightweight "energy compass" that is evaluated during training and selects the most coherent candidate sequence to guide trajectory generation. This process only increases the training cost. In the 170 million-parameter language modeling task, the shaped 8-step student model was 32% less perplexed and 128 times faster than the 1024-step teacher model, and performed consistently across different data and model sizes. This method achieves the best perplexity over all compared baselines, including those using more data or larger models.
